culpritSource.quote: The test Kogoro suggested earlier shows that the arrow was not shot due to the difference between the dummy and the corpse: The corpse leans back more than the dummy. This proves that both of the brothers were innocent, and the only possible culprit is none other than Chinatsu Tachibana. She stabbed the victim with the arrow to revenge for her parents.

resolution.zhHans: 毛利小五郎先前提议的试验表明，箭并非因假人与尸体的差异而射出：尸体比假人向后倾斜得更多。这证明两兄弟都是清白的，唯一可能的犯人正是 Chinatsu Tachibana。她用箭刺中被害人，为父母报仇。被害人：Chinatsu Tachibana 的父母 死因：勒死
resolution.en: The test Kogoro suggested earlier shows that the arrow was not shot due to the difference between the dummy and the corpse: The corpse leans back more than the dummy. This proves that both of the brothers were innocent, and the only possible culprit is none other than Chinatsu Tachibana. She stabbed the victim with the arrow to revenge for her parents. Victim: Chinatsu Tachibana's parents Cause of death: Strangulation

summary.en: The victim is Juro Dan, the chairman of Dan Juro Food. At first glance, everyone believes that someone stood at the top of the Dan Juro Food office to commit the killing shot. Kogoro suggests they test the theory with a dummy.

victims.name: Juro Dan
victims.causeOfDeath: Blood loss caused by an arrow shot to the throat

suspects: Hitotsu Dan, Futatsu Dan, and Chinatsu Tachibana
